# Smartsheet

> Smartsheet is an AI-powered intelligent work management platform enabling enterprise teams to automate workflows, manage projects and portfolios, and collaborate across the organization.

Smartsheet provides a comprehensive suite of work management solutions including core platform capabilities (Gantt, Kanban, dashboards), advanced modules (Resource Management, Control Center, Dynamic View, WorkApps), and specialized solutions for project management, operations, and IT portfolio management. The platform integrates with leading enterprise systems like Jira, Salesforce, and Power BI, and features Smartsheet AI powered by Claude for intelligent automation and data analysis.

## Key Topics

- Intelligent Work Management
- AI-Powered Automation
- Project Portfolio Management
- Workflow Automation

- [WorkApps | Smartsheet](https://www.smartsheet.com/platform/workapps): WorkApps no-code platform for building role-based apps with sheets and dashboards
